selection_policy: Automated by scripts/model_select.py. Separate tracks for generate and edit. Primary: Artificial Analysis arena (most photo-specific category available, else Overall). Secondary: LMArena/arena.ai. Switch only on a statistically separated lead (margin > combined 95% CI), or margin >= 25 Elo with secondary agreement, or a local photoreal duel when tied. Then use the highest-ranked model that a configured provider actually serves.

models.prompt_dialect: natural-language labeled sections, 120-250 words; avoid-list as plain sentences (no negative_prompt field); exact text in double quotes
known_weaknesses: drifts to clean/commercial gloss unless told otherwise
slight warm cast and shallow-DOF bokeh by default
fine organic repeating textures (foliage, fur, fog, crowds) can show cellular/noise artifacts
sizes above 2560x1440 are experimental: more artifacts/composition shifts
high complexity on edits changes areas outside the instruction
same family weaknesses as 2.6; slightly lower arena score
speed-optimised sibling: less fine detail than Sunburst

models.prompt_dialect: natural language (verify in vendor docs during onboarding)
